summary: Node bench rda_layer_node (one RDA layer incl. the chunked core, 3 fresh processes per arm alternating, bit-identical outputs): the fused conv+prepare / wave gated-norm layer is faster than the incumbent at every measured row count at or above the floor, ms per layer rows 64/128/192/256/384/512/1024/2048/4096/16384: incumbent 0.122/0.172/0.223/0.286/0.429/0.604/1.232/2.439/4.841/19.34, fused 0.083/0.132/0.172/0.232/0.367/0.461/0.923/1.806/3.610/14.58 (-32% ... -25%). The floor 64 is the chunked core's own admission floor (GATED_DELTA_VECTOR_CHUNK_MIN_ROWS); decode and speculative verify rows (< 64, or a taped verify) keep the incumbent launches, which the digest check shows are unchanged at rows 1/2/3/16/63.
